ticket_control_plane.purpose: Authorize issue state and enforce duplicate-task protection before computation.

invariants: The three business centers are peers and never call, dispatch, import, read runtime artifacts from, or write runtime artifacts to each other.
GPTs is the only controller, courier and evidence relay between centers.
An API result becomes compute input only after GPTs retrieves and verifies the complete snapshot, manifest and hashes, then creates a new compute ticket.
A compute result becomes expert evidence only after GPTs retrieves and verifies the complete result package, then creates a new expert ticket.
The numerical compute runtime never fetches business data, calls models, downloads code or contacts another center.
The compute ticket control plane may contact only api.github.com for issue authorization and duplicate protection; it may not fetch business data.
No center may silently repair another center's data, assumptions, prompts, code, workflow or output.
The maintenance actor may modify repository code and run repository-wide audits but is not a runtime business-center relay.
